notes: RRB JE cutoffs are **zone-wise and post-category-wise** — every Railway Recruitment Board declares its own figures for each post category (Cat. No.), so there is no single national cutoff. Two different scales are used. **CBT 1 cutoffs are normalised marks out of 100** and only shortlist you for CBT 2, subject to the category minimums (UR/EWS 40%, OBC-NCL and SC 30%, ST 25%). **Cutoffs after CBT 2 are the Merit Index on a 350 to 900 scale** (350 at the general-category qualifying mark of 40, 900 at the mean of the top 0.1% of candidates), because candidates of different engineering branches compete on one common list. The rows below are exact figures from the official result-and-cutoff PDFs of **RRB Chandigarh** (shown as a representative board); your zone's cutoffs come from its own RRB website. Cat. No. refers to the post-category numbering of each CEN (mapping given per row).
